title: SessionResumePolicy
description: Stage R3 — declarative resume policy for the local bridge. The Rust runtime parses this file via `RawResumePolicy`, normalizes it into `SessionResumePolicy`, and is the sole source of truth for actual enforcement. The YAML is a *control plane*: it can only narrow or pick between behaviors the runtime already supports.

version.description: Config schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes.

default_mode.description: Resume mode selected when the client omits `resume_mode` on `session.resume`. Mirrors the three modes the translator already knows.

native_fallback.description: What to do when `native_or_replay` reaches a non-supporting agent. `replay_only` mirrors today's silent fallback; `fail` makes the situation explicit instead.

mcp_server_drift.description: What to do when persisted MCP servers differ from the live agent registry advertisement at resume time. `ignore` suppresses the event entirely.

profile_class_mismatch.description: What to do when a persisted `profile_class` does not equal the live profile's class (Stage R2 hard-gate). Only `fail` is currently honored by the runtime; `warn` is reserved for a future relaxed mode.

retention_days.description: How long persisted session metadata is kept before background cleanup considers it stale. Bounded so a typo can't accidentally request multi-decade retention.

max_events.description: Per-session event ceiling enforced by persistence/replay. Older events beyond this are dropped at append time.
